input.quote: IBM grants Customer a nonexclusive, revocable license to use the Base Components solely in connection with the Services as provided under this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Base Components licence is expressly revocable at IBM's discretion and names neither our Affiliates nor our contractors, which is walk-away territory. Redline makes the licence irrevocable except on expiry or termination under Section 3 and extends it to Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf.

input.quote: IBM reserves the right to investigate potential violations of the representations and warranties in Subsection 11.2(b).
input.rationale: There is no usage audit, inspection or verification right against us. The only investigatory right is limited to suspected Acceptable Use Policy breaches, carries a notification obligation before access is restricted, and gives IBM no access to our systems or records. Nothing to redline.
